data.content: Scope correction after independent review: knots-c472 authorizes only signed proposal promotion into a protected inbox. It does not construct generation/control objects, and ccdc has no GitHub provider adapter/replay entrypoint. knots-74e2 therefore owns GitHub enforcement, protected writer registry, and atomic signed proposal promotion only. A new provider-integrator execution Knot owns consuming protected inboxes, invoking ccdc, publishing immutable canonical/archive generations, and advancing control by exact CAS. This avoids shipping a fake publication contract. Legacy freeze remains staged disabled for d6e4.
